items.title: Collect F-009 and related Layer2 proof context
items.context: Use Lattice commands and existing decision docs to identify the exact suspected gap without touching .omx or treating stale artifacts as proof.
items.userSees: Context evidence lists F-009 text, suspected gap, source anchors, and related Layer2/Authority docs without using .omx.

happy.desc: F-009 finding text and related Layer2/Authority decision docs are cited in the execution plan.

edge.desc: The plan distinguishes suspected evidence from verified evidence and does not treat stale artifacts as proof.

adversarial.desc: No .omx path or legacy artifact root is used as source of truth.

items.title: Produce two host execution-plan drafts
items.context: Run Claude CLI and Codex CLI as independent read-only hosts. Each should propose a minimal executable plan for resolving or disproving F-009 under the four principles.
items.userSees: Two independent host drafts from Claude CLI and Codex CLI are available as input to the final document synthesis.

happy.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI each produce a bounded F-009 execution-plan draft.

edge.desc: The final document records host input without making either host an Authority.

adversarial.desc: Host suggestions that add arbitrary optimization or false capability claims are excluded.

items.title: Write audited F-009 execution document and NAV entry
items.context: Synthesize only agreed correctness requirements into a decision doc under docs/requirements/decisions and update NAV count/link. Do not add capability claims.
items.userSees: A new decision document appears under docs/requirements/decisions and NAV links to it with the updated count.

happy.desc: The F-009 execution document is created and NAV count/link are updated.

edge.desc: The document states it is plan-only and cannot unlock Layer2 by itself.

adversarial.desc: The document does not broaden scope into Layer3/Layer4/global claims or production Authority implementation.

items.title: Audit the finished document
items.context: Final auditor checks executability, host-neutrality, non-authority boundary, fail-closed claim logic, and the four principles before DONE.
items.userSees: Final audit reports PASS for executability, host-neutrality, non-authority boundary, and logical consistency, or records blockers explicitly.

happy.desc: Final audit confirms the document gives an executable path to resolve or disprove F-009.

edge.desc: Audit checks consistency with existing Layer2 unlock, artifact isolation, lifecycle receipt, and Authority receipt docs.

adversarial.desc: Audit rejects false PASS language, missing fail-closed rules, and any local CLI Authority overclaim.
